yuelu-academy.name: Yuelu Academy
yuelu-academy.tip: One of China's oldest seats of learning. Go early to walk the courtyards before tour groups arrive.

orange-isle.name: Orange Isle
orange-isle.price_text: Free to enter; small fee for some rides
orange-isle.hours: Island open daily; check last ferry or metro time
orange-isle.tip: A long island in the Xiang River. Walk or rent a bike; the far tip has the best river views.

hunan-museum.name: Hunan Museum
hunan-museum.price_text: Free; book a timed slot online in advance
hunan-museum.tip: Home of the Mawangdui tombs and the Han silk banner. Reserve online; slots fill fast on weekends.

ifs-tower.name: Changsha IFS Tower T1
ifs-tower.price_text: Free to enter the mall; rooftop viewing area may charge
ifs-tower.tip: The rooftop terrace has the KAWS figures and skyline views. Go near sunset for photos.

pozi-street.name: Pozi Street food street
pozi-street.price_text: Pay per stall; snacks from a few CNY
pozi-street.hours: Busiest from late afternoon to late night
pozi-street.tip: Try stinky tofu and sugar-oil baba. Bring small cash and expect crowds on weekends.

huangxing-road.name: Huangxing Road pedestrian street
huangxing-road.tip: Changsha's main shopping and people-watching strip. Combine it with Pozi Street nearby.

juzizhou-bridge.name: Xiang River bridge walk at Orange Isle
juzizhou-bridge.tip: Walk the bridge onto the island for river and skyline views. Best light is just before sunset.

yuelu-mountain.name: Yuelu Mountain trails
yuelu-mountain.price_text: Free; cable car or shuttle extra
yuelu-mountain.hours: Trails open daily; cable car daytime only
yuelu-mountain.tip: A wooded hill above the academy. Wear trainers; paths are steep in places.

aiwan-pavilion.name: Aiwan Pavilion
aiwan-pavilion.tip: A classic red pavilion on Yuelu Mountain. A short stop on the way up or down.

taiping-street.name: Taiping Street old lane
taiping-street.tip: A restored old street with snacks and small shops. Quieter in the morning than at night.

juzizhou-head.name: Orange Isle head viewpoint
juzizhou-head.tip: The southern tip of the island looks back at the city skyline. Bring water; it is a long walk.

helong-sports.name: Helong Sports Center night market area
helong-sports.tip: Local barbecue and street snacks away from the main tourist strip. Check opening days on the day.

kaifu-temple.name: Kaifu Temple
kaifu-temple.price_text: Small entry fee (check on the day)
kaifu-temple.tip: A working Buddhist temple north of the centre. Dress modestly and keep voices low.

xiang-river-cruise.name: Xiang River evening cruise
xiang-river-cruise.price_text: ≈ CNY 80–150 depending on boat (check on the day)
xiang-river-cruise.tip: See the riverside lights from the water. Book ahead on weekends and confirm the pier.

wuyi-square.name: Wuyi Square and surroundings
wuyi-square.hours: Always open; shops daytime to late
wuyi-square.tip: The city's central hub. Good base for walking to the food streets and IFS Tower.

mawangdui-site.name: Mawangdui Han tomb site area
mawangdui-site.tip: The famous finds are in Hunan Museum; visit there first unless you have a special interest.

changsha-south.name: Changsha South Station area walk
changsha-south.tip: Handy if you arrive by high-speed rail. Not a sight in itself; use it as a transit stop.

juzizhou-ferry.name: Orange Isle ferry crossing
juzizhou-ferry.price_text: Small ferry fare (check on the day)
juzizhou-ferry.tip: A short river crossing is easier than the long bridge walk. Confirm the last boat back.

yuelu-gate-food.name: Snack stalls near Yuelu Academy gate
yuelu-gate-food.tip: Quick local snacks before or after the academy. Prices are modest; bring cash.
